title: Energy-Efficient Accelerator for Scalable Point Transformer Networks with Reduced Data Access
problem: Point cloud transformer networks have high data access requirements for attention computation, making them energy-inefficient. Current accelerators struggle with scalability for large point clouds.
motivation: Point cloud processing is critical for 3D vision and autonomous systems; energy-efficient hardware enables deployment on power-constrained devices.
method: Hardware accelerator for 3D point cloud transformers using panel-level kernel mapping to reduce data access patterns. Locality-based compression for attention layers. Optimized data flow to minimize memory bandwidth.
key_novelty: Panel-level kernel mapping with locality-based compression for energy-efficient point transformer acceleration.
contributions: Scalable architecture for large point clouds
limitations: Specific performance metrics and energy measurements not detailed in abstract; generalization to other transformer types unclear.
